title: DUA-D2C: Dynamic Uncertainty Aware Method for Overfitting Remediation in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2411.15876v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Overfitting remains a significant challenge in deep learning, often arising from data outliers, noise, and limited training data. To address this, we previously proposed the Divide2Conquer (D2C) method, which partitions training data into multiple subsets and trains identical models independently on each. This strategy enables learning more consistent patterns while minimizing the influence of individual outliers and noise. D2C's standard aggregation typically treats all subset models equally or based on fixed heuristics (like data size), potentially underutilizing information about their varying generalization capabilities. Building upon this foundation, we introduce Dynamic Uncertainty-Aware Divide2Conquer (DUA-D2C), an advanced technique that refines the aggregation process. DUA-D2C dynamically weights the contributions of subset models based on their performance on a shared validation set, employing a novel composite score

translated_title: DUA-D2C：一种用于解决深度学习过拟合问题的动态不确定性感知方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2411.15876v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：过拟合仍然是深度学习中的一个重大挑战，其成因通常包括数据异常值、噪声以及训练数据有限。为解决这一问题，我们此前提出了分而治之（Divide2Conquer，D2C）方法，该方法将训练数据划分为多个子集，并在每个子集上独立训练相同的模型。这一策略使模型能够学习到更一致的模式，同时最小化单个异常值和噪声的影响。然而，D2C的标准聚合方式通常对所有子集模型一视同仁，或仅基于固定启发式规则（如数据规模）进行处理，这可能未能充分利用子集模型泛化能力各不相同的信息。在此基础上，我们提出了动态不确定性感知分而治之（Dynamic Uncertainty-Aware Divide2Conquer，DUA-D2C），这是一种对聚合过程进行优化的先进技术。DUA-D2C根据各子集模型在共享验证集上的表现，动态地为它们的贡献分配权重，并采用一种新颖的复合评分机制……
tldr: 本文提出DUA-D2C方法，通过基于子集模型在共享验证集上的表现动态加权其贡献，改进了D2C的聚合过程，从而更有效地缓解深度学习中的过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: DUA-D2C improves the D2C framework by dynamically weighting the contributions of subset models based on their performance on a shared validation set using a novel composite score, offering a more effective remedy for overfitting in deep learning.
